title: rusty-v8-v150.4.0
contentText: Update rusty_v8 to 150.4.0 ( #35831 ) ## What changed - Upgrade the Rust `v8` crate to `150.4.0` and the Bazel V8 source to `15.0.245.2`. - Refresh the prebuilt archives, checksums, LLVM source revisions, Bazel targets, and downstream V8 patches for the new release. - Expose the pinned llvm-libc headers under V8's expected include path for source builds.
